page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin holds three marginal notes: "Gal.1." beside the italic quotation, "Conclusio primæ partis." beside the paragraph about the Church's testimony, and "2.Pars. Argumenta certitudinē Scripturę ostendentia." beside the start of the next paragraph. Running head at top. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: narratione mulieris, vt in Christum crederent: postquam vero Christum ipsum vidissent atque audiuissent, ita confirmabantur, vt se crediturosjam[?] dicerent, etiam tacente muliere: Ita fieri potest, vt nondum conuersi, vel adhuc infirmi, Ecclesiæ testimonio tanquam in ipsorum oculos magis incurrente, moueantur potissimum ad fidem Scripturæ habendam, qui tamen postquam vberiore luce fidei illustrati sunt, longè superiori ac certiori testimonio, Scripturam esse Dei verbum, confirmari experiuntur, eiusque vi & evidentia fidem sibi retinendam esse intelligunt, etiamsi omnes Angeli & homines diuersum sentirent, iuxta dictum: Etiamsi nos, aut angelus de cœlo evangelizet vobis praeter id quod evangelizauimus vobis,Gal.1. anathema sit. Ex his igitur potest intelligi, vocem & consensum Ecclesiæ Catholicæ, posse quidem & debereConclusio primæ partis. inter alia testimonia, confirmationi nostræ seruire: nec tamen authoritatem Sacræ Scripturæ ab ea pendere: sed ex ipsa Scriptura potius discì oportere, quibus argumentis eam diuinitus traditam esse, nobis agnoscendum sit: nimirum quia Deus ipse hoc testatur, eaque doctrinæ cœlestis vis & ratio est, vt etiam contradicentibus cunctis hominibus, hanc esse Dei vocem non aliunde manifestius ac certius, quàm ex ipsa cognosci queat.

2.Pars. Argumenta certitudinē Scripturę ostendentia.Sed ne quis existimet, argumentis vllis, quę etiam ratio naturali luce firma esse iudicat, apud impios absque singulari Spiritus sancti gratia hoc effici, vt vel obtemperent veritati, vel in eam contumeliosi esse desinant: principio meminisse oportet, argumenta siue testimonia esse duplicia, quę Christianæ Religionis certitudinem ostendunt, & Scripturæ sacræ authoritatem tuentur. Vnicum quippe testimonium est, solis Christi Spiritu renatis proprium, & his solis cognitum, cuius ea vis est, vt non modò veritatem doctrinæ Propheticæ & Apostolicæ abundè in animis nostris testetur & obsignet, sed corda etiam ad ample-

page.notes: Printed page number at top left is an old-style "20"; read as 20 with doubt. Faint reference marks in the left margin near the first lines (a small triangle and dots beside "quevi") are not legible as text and were not transcribed. The word "crediturosiam" in the text is uncertain; the "i" may be a j. "Etiamsi" and "de" in the italic quotation are read from an italic scan and may differ slightly. The bottom-right catchword is set with a ligature "st" and is read as "tendam" with doubt; it continues the hyphenated "ample-". The line "esse desinant" is read from a long-s ligature and may be "effe". No show-through or stamps were transcribed.
